title: AutoEIA Module Metadata
description: Schema for AutoEIA analysis module metadata.json files. Every module must include this file alongside its Python implementation.

name.description: Unique module identifier in snake_case. Must match the Python filename (e.g. 'shadow_tier3_projection' → 'shadow_tier3_projection.py').

display_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the UI node header.

emoji.description: Optional single emoji for visual identification in the module palette.

description.description: What this module analyzes, which methodology it implements, and what regulatory framework it supports.

category.description: Module category for grouping in the UI palette.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdictions where this module's methodology applies. Common values: 'NYC', 'NYS', 'generic'.

inputs.description: Input port definitions. Each key becomes a field in the node's configuration panel.

outputs.description: Output port definitions. Each key must be present in the dict returned by execute().

type.description: UI widget and validation type for this input.

description.description: Shown below the input field in the UI. Be specific about units, format, and defaults.

optional.description: If false (default), the workflow engine will warn when this input is not provided.

default.description: Default value shown as placeholder in the UI. Any JSON-compatible type.

enum.description: Required when type='enum'. List of allowed string values rendered as a dropdown.

options.description: Required when type='multiselect'. List of checkbox options.

type.description: Determines how the output is rendered in the results panel.

description.description: What this output contains and how downstream modules can use it.
